public_rationale: Read with the sentences that follow it, the claim is that Sora and Pika could not reliably produce a specific requested video with consistent details. OpenAI's Sora launch page of February 15, 2024 (e1) says the model 'may also confuse spatial details included in a prompt, such as discerning left from right, or struggle with precise descriptions of events that unfold over time, like specific camera trajectories.' A hands-on review of Pika 1.0 published on December 22, 2023 (e2) found 'no guarantee' that a follow-on clip would 'look anything like the first.' It reported similar problems getting Pika to follow specific style suggestions and said users must deal with 'a lot of trial and error.' The same OpenAI page also says Sora maintains 'adherence to the user's prompt' (e3). That is the developer's own description, not an evaluation, and the page also lists prompt-following limits. On the plain reading, this evidence supports the claim.
limitations: The phrase 'not particularly adept' is vague and sets no threshold. A different reading could change the result.
Sora was not public during the period. The only Sora evidence is the developer's own disclosure, and no independent tests exist.
The Pika evidence comes from one hands-on opinion review. A more positive Tom's Guide review was not read.
No task-based benchmark of either tool from the period was found.
